“I have surely heard Ephraim grieving thus, ‘You have chastised me, and I was chastised, as an untrained calf. Turn me…

“He arose, and came to his father. But while he was still far off, his father saw him, and was moved with compassion…
He prayed to Yahweh, and said, “Please, Yahweh, wasn’t this what I said when I was still in my own country? Therefore I…

Tear your heart, and not your garments, and turn to Yahweh, your God; for he is gracious and merciful, slow to anger…
Yahweh relented concerning this. “It shall not be,” says Yahweh.
Yahweh relented concerning this. “This also shall not be,” says the Lord Yahweh.

parallels.note: So Yahweh turned away from the evil which he said he would do to his people.

translations.web: God saw their works, that they turned from their evil way. God relented of the disaster which he said he would do to them, and he didn’t do it.
translations.bsb: When God saw their actions—that they had turned from their evil ways—He relented from the disaster He had threatened to bring upon them.
